item.title: Massive cooldown stirring up severe weather chances
item.description: A powerful cold front will sweep across the Midwest on Sunday, bringing record highs to an abrupt end and transitioning to overnight lows in the teens, with wind gusts of 40 to 50 mph and a chance of an isolated thunderstorm.

item.title: Surge in post-Christmas returns as shoppers fix holiday errors
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — The days following Christmas are among the busiest of the year for retailers, as millions of shoppers head back to stores to exchange gifts, correct order mistakes, or return items that didn’t match expectations. item.title: Winter Blast: Tracking a massive 50 degree drop in temperatures
item.description: A powerful cold front will sweep across the Ozarks on Sunday, bringing a massive nosedive in temperatures and gusty winds, with a line of showers and isolated thunderstorms possible, and temperatures expected to fall into the teens by Monday morning.

item.title: Springfield residents reflect on Christmas, look ahead to New Year with hope
item.description: Christmas celebrations continue across the Ozarks, with many people looking ahead to the new year and hoping for fresh starts, from rebuilding relationships to pursuing dreams and celebrating family.

item.title: Frigid feel won't last, milder weather returns in time for the new year
item.description: A strong cold front has brought a blast of arctic air to the Ozarks, with temperatures dropping from the 70s to the 20s and wind chills dropping below zero, but warmer air is expected to return on Tuesday, with the new year starting off mild.

item.title: Memorable Christmas heat wave
item.description: December 2025 was one of the warmest on record, with temperatures reaching record highs in the 70s and 20s, and less than a quarter of an inch of precipitation.

item.title: Shell Knob woman dies in fatal Barry County crash
item.description: A 74-year-old woman was killed and a 45-year-old man was seriously injured in a crash near Golden, Missouri on Saturday, Dec. 27.

item.title: Springfield woman gets 12-year sentence for child kidnapping
item.description: Michelle Porter, 43, of Springfield, Missouri, was sentenced to 12 years in prison for kidnapping, 10 years for endangering the welfare of a child, and 10 years for tampering with a motor vehicle after pleading guilty to stealing a truck with a woman with dementia inside and then kidnapping two children.

item.title: Body discovered as Christmas Day fire destroys Taney County home
item.description: A Christmas Day house fire in Taney County left one person dead and a home completely destroyed after flames spread on Thursday afternoon, prompting a second alarm and a large response from volunteer firefighters.

item.title: Springfield police investigating fatal single-vehicle crash
item.description: A single-vehicle crash in Springfield Saturday night resulted in the death of the driver, who was ejected from the vehicle after it struck a guardrail.
